- Late_Blight, Gray_Mold, Alternaria: show aerial symptoms
- Phytophthora_Blight, Verticillium_Wilt: different symptom profiles / not tomato in reference
- Anthracnose: fruit lesions

The sudden, complete whole-plant collapse with still-green leaves, affecting individual plants while neighbors remain healthy, on black plastic mulch — is the hallmark of bacterial wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum), and the Bacterial_Wilt reference image is the closest visual match.
